events.title: Hormuz tanker traffic COLLAPSED — 5 Sat, 0 Sun vs 31 prior weekend
events.summary: Tanker traffic through Strait of Hormuz has drastically slowed: only 5 commodity vessels transited Saturday, zero registered for Sunday, versus 31 the prior weekend (Kpler data). UAE accuses Iran of attacking 3rd ADNOC vessel Friday. Iran FM says no decision to resume talks. Trump urges Americans to accept higher gasoline prices. Brent at $88.72.

events.title: Kushner lands in Israel — meets Netanyahu after historic Hamas meeting
events.summary: Jared Kushner landed in Israel Monday Aug 17 after meeting Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya in Cairo with Qatar/Egypt/Turkey officials. Accompanied by Mladenov and Tony Blair. First direct Kushner-Hamas meeting since October ceasefire. Working to advance Trump's Gaza ceasefire plan. 8 nations condemn Israeli rejection.

events.title: Ebola deadliest in DRC history — 2,325 deaths, accelerating
events.summary: Ebola outbreak killed 2,325 people (Aug 16 gov data), surpassing 2018-2020 outbreak as deadliest in DRC history. Bundibugyo strain — no approved treatments. WHO: deaths outside known transmission chains. On pace to eclipse 2014-2016 (11,000 deaths). 4,727 confirmed infections. Bunia market epicenter struggling.

events.title: China credit contraction — July new loans NEGATIVE (-340B yuan), first on record
events.summary: China's new yuan loans fell sharply to -340 billion yuan in July (down from +1.61T in June), first negative on record. PBOC injected $52B unusual liquidity via overnight reverse repos. Aggregate financing growth slowed to 7.4%. RMB loan growth at 5.2%. Credit demand collapsing alongside property crisis. Delayed July data looms.

events.title: Yen intervention unraveling — USD/JPY at 159-160, BofA warns 165
events.summary: USD/JPY back in 159-160 range. $85B joint US-Japan intervention half erased. BofA: break above 160 + inaction = credibility collapse, could hit 165. JPM keeps USD/JPY at 164. BOJ raised to 1% in June (highest since 1995). Sept hike 80% priced. Government pushing for earlier hike. ESF sold euros (first since 1998).

events.title: Oil at $88.72 — Hormuz keeps prices elevated, OPEC cuts demand forecast
events.summary: Brent at $88.72 (+0.2%), WTI at $82.35. Both gained 5%+ last week on ADNOC tanker attacks and Saudi Aramco refinery hit. OPEC lowered 2026 demand growth to 580kbpd (4th consecutive cut). EIA forecasts elevated prices until Hormuz flows normalize. SPR at 304.8 mbbl (multi-decade low).

events.title: US Fed at 3.50-3.75% — 3 members wanted hike, September decision looms
events.summary: FOMC held rates at 3.50-3.75% with 9-3 vote, three members favoring a hike. Futures pricing one additional 25bp cut by year-end. BOJ at 1%, ECB at 2.25%. Policy divergence creating currency stress. Yen weakness partly driven by rate differentials.

events.title: UK housing slump — steepest August drop since 2018, hiring freeze
events.summary: UK asking prices fell 2.0% in four weeks to Aug 8, steepest August drop since 2018. CIPD survey shows employers in low-hire, low-fire mode. Soft data backdrop ahead of BoE meeting. Not a Category-5 event but adds to global economic softness picture.
